audit.headline: Worth fixing — mobile is the big problem
audit.reasoning: The content is solid (8.0/10 across 5 pages), so the site is worth keeping — it does not work properly on phones (mobile 1.0/10), the styling is dated. Keep their design, structure and photos, and fix what is actually broken.

categories.name: Mobile & responsive
notes: No viewport meta — the site renders zoomed-out on phones
10 fixed pixel widths may overflow on small screens

categories.name: Design & polish
notes: No CSS variables — styling is hard-coded

categories.name: Images & media
notes: Only 7% of images have alt text
No lazy loading — slower first paint
